(5) IT IS IN THE SOURCE, NOT AN INFERENCE. src/render/stage.js streakNode builds the cross-section as `s.pow(q)` with `s = 1-u^2` and `qc = mix(U.fQCore, float(0.5), mB)`, mB = smoothstep(0,0.45,b/R) -- so wherever defocus dominates the exponent is driven to 0.5, whose w90/w50 is exactly 0.503. That family is bounded: (1-u^2)^q gives 0.503 at q=0.5 and asymptotes to 0.390 as q grows, so NO exponent in it can reach the plates' 0.29-0.30. The reference cross-section is cuspier AND longer-tailed than any member of the family being used. fix: src/render/stage.js, streakNode, the two lines `const qc = mix(U.fQCore, float(0.5), mB)` and `const qw = mix(U.fQWarm, float(0.5), mB)` (~1834-1835). Stop converging the cross-section on a defocus disc. The 0.5 target is correct optics for an aperture and wrong for this object, and both plates say so on the new frozen probe: a real flare's blurred cross-section reads w90/w50 0.300 (plate-01) and 0.286 (plate-02), while (1-u^2)^q is mathematically bounded at 0.503 (q=0.5) down to 0.390 (q->inf) and cannot reach either. Replace the blurred limb with a glare PSF that has BOTH a cusp and long tails -- e.g. carry the core as `1/(1+ (u/a)^2)^n` or `exp(-|u|/a)` and let `b/R` grow `a` instead of flattening an exponent -- and keep the existing `U.fHalo` skirt, which is the one lobe already shaped right. While you are in there the near end has no source: `lens 00-hero.png` gives ribbon peak 46.0/85.7/98.4 on the three near stations against plate-01's 225.8/241.4/233.7, so raise `U.fHot`'s reach along the span, or drop `U.fKappa` below 0.65, until the white core survives to both frame edges instead of dying 60% of the way across -- plate-01's peak_max/peak_min is 1.49, ours is 5.19. ACCEPTANCE, on the SHIPPED hero and on shots/r7-iphone/04-cut+250ms through the frozen suite: `filament` flattop_p50 into 0.29-0.34 and flattop_p90 under 0.55 on BOTH (today 0.409/0.548 and 0.500/0.667), `lens` ribbon peak_max/peak_min under 2.5 (today 5.19), while holding what round 7 won -- fwhm_max_over_min >= 3.5 and edge_1090_p50 <= 2.8 on the hero, and edge_max_over_min <= 4.5 on 09-combo. SEPARATELY AND NON-NEGOTIABLY: peakDrawCalls is 123 landscape and 153 in shots/r7-iphone against R4's 120 ceiling, having been 88 in r6; that has to come back under 120 in PORTRAIT, which is the shipping configuration, before this piece can be called done at any score. AND A NOTE FOR WHOEVER ADDS THE NEXT PROBE, so you do not repeat my dead end: I tried to instrument the mitre crease by tracking the ridge crest's perpendicular offset per station and fitting a straight line to it. It does not work -- any bright object inside the +/-26 px window steals the profile's argmax, and plate-01 is full of them, so the REFERENCE scored crest_resid_max 20.011 px against r7's 16.722, i.e. the control lost to the render and the statistic was measuring debris density. Per-third re-fits of the ridge angle fail the same way (plate-01's thirds return 23/45/71 deg because two thirds of that frame are fruit, not streak). A working kink detector has to track the crest by CONTINUITY from a seeded station, never by per-station argmax. I deleted mine rather than quote it.
